clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says for decades there were no seminars, no YouTube, no workshops, no audio courses - just two ways to learn success.

One: find a rich person and become their apprentice. Work for them, study them, mimic their thinking, their words, their actions.

Two: read books. Kevin Trudeau says books actually change the size of the hippocampus in the brain, more than audio ever does - and that is what lets you broadcast the frequency that attracts money into your life.

Which path have you actually been taking - studying success up close, or just scrolling past it?

#kevintrudeau #successmindset #wealthhabits #readingbooks #mindset #manifestation
clips.send: A broke 20-something sends it to themselves: hope - for decades the only shortcut to rich was an apprenticeship or a stack of books, and books are still free at the library.
